hero.subtitle: A Computer Engineering Student
hero.description: Exploring technology, building innovative solutions, and learning every day to turn ideas into reality.

about.shortBio: I'm a Computer Engineering student at Sankalchand Patel College of Engineering (SPCE), passionate about full-stack web development, databases, and exploring new technologies.
about.extendedBio: I enjoy building clean, dependable software across the entire stack — from foundational problem-solving in C, C++, and Java to responsive user interfaces with React.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, backed by Python, Django, PHP, MySQL, and solid DBMS architecture.

projectsSection.title: Some of My Projects
projectsSection.subtitle: A glimpse of my work and creations.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.shortDescription: A modern, animated and responsive portfolio website built with React.js to showcase my skills and projects.
projects.fullDescription: Designed and engineered an interactive personal portfolio featuring fluid scroll animations, responsive layouts, customizable themes, project showcase modals, and a built-in content editor for seamless updates.

projects.title: SPCE Study Hub
projects.shortDescription: A centralized academic notes and study resource platform tailored for Computer Engineering students.
projects.fullDescription: Full-stack web application powered by Python and Django with MySQL database integration. Enables semester-wise syllabus notes browsing, quick search filtering, and curated lab resources.

projects.title: Student DBMS Portal
projects.shortDescription: Relational database management system for handling student attendance, grades, and academic records.
projects.fullDescription: Built using PHP, MySQL, and structured DBMS normalization principles with role-based access, clean query optimization, dynamic reporting tables, and an intuitive web dashboard.

projects.title: Core Algorithms & OOP Toolkit
projects.shortDescription: Collection of data structures, sorting visualizers, and object-oriented utilities implemented in C, C++, and Java.
projects.fullDescription: Modular programming toolkit exploring linked lists, trees, graph traversals, memory management in C/C++, and clean object-oriented design patterns in Java.
